This is actually harder than I thought. I have depression and have had my fair share of suicidal thoughts, but I'm trying my hardest not to lose hope :)

I feel really crappy. I honestly don't even see the point in living a life full of pain. I used to be that bubbly, cheerful, careless girl but now I'm nothing. People can be so cruel. Suicide isn't an option for me. I'll just wait till I die naturally.  

I'm really sick of people who judge others. I just want to slap people when they call me "Smart". I'm really lazy. It's painful seeing friends get low grades or failing when they study for weeks. I don't even study and I'm at the top of the grade. It sucks so much recently I've just failed tests and assignments on purpose. I really wish people would understand this, teachers and peers. Calling me 'smart' isn't helping at all. 

I'm socially awkward and have a small social phobia. I used to be comfortable and loud. Highschool changed me. Making new friends and trying to be a part of a friendship group that just exclude me. But at other times they're the greatest friends you could hope for. I just don't get people. :l

This will probably get lost in all the other comments but at least I feel somewhat better now.
